long_description:
60-minute yoga flow and beverage social at the Trophy Maywood taproom. sign up includes one beverage. all experience levels welcome!

About this Event

Sunday Yoga classes take place monthly at Trophy Brewing's Maywood location. Join us inside the brewery or out on the lawn for a 60-minute yoga flow for all experience levels. Beginners welcome! Bring your mat and any props you like to use.

Registration includes one drink ticket, so stick around after class to enjoy a Trophy pint or non-alcoholic beverage and relax with the crew—great way to start your Sunday FUNday.

Also check out other in Raleigh, Health & Wellness events in Raleigh, Workshops in Raleigh.
